> 👋 Welcome! No question is too basic. This template is meant for churches with little or no developer support — if you're stuck, that's a template problem, not your problem.

**Which step are you stuck on?**

Pick the closest:

- [ ] Creating the repo from "Use this template"
- [ ] Installing Node.js or Git
- [ ] Running `npm install` or `npm run setup`
- [ ] Customizing branding (logo, photos, colors)
- [ ] Deploying to Vercel
- [ ] Connecting our domain
- [ ] Setting up CMS authentication / inviting editors
- [ ] Something else (describe below)

**What did you try, and what happened?**

A couple of sentences is plenty. Screenshots of error messages help.

**Which doc were you following (if any)?**

(File path or URL — e.g. `docs/for-tech-volunteers/06-deploy-to-vercel.md`)

**Your environment:**

- Operating system: <!-- macOS / Windows / Linux / Codespaces -->
- Node.js version: <!-- run `node -v` to find out, or leave blank if you haven't installed it -->
- Anything unusual about your setup? <!-- e.g. behind a corporate firewall, no admin access on the computer, etc. -->

**Anything else useful?**

(Optional. The name of your church and a one-line description of your situation can help us tailor the answer.)
